phase_0.boundary_condition: The hermetic vessel seal (⊣/TANCH) closes the work; no influence enters or leaves once the seal is set. The vessel itself is the alembic — a single register holding interior and boundary as one.

VINIT.justification: The void before the work begins — unformed potential, the chaotic mass before any operation names it. Corresponds to ⊢ (𐑦) in the grounded tuple.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor that closes the vessel. Once the seal sits, the work is complete — success, failure, or paradox are all contained. Corresponds to ⊣ (𐑰).

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism: the matter opens, volatilizes, ascends. The directed transformation toward the volatile principle. Corresponds to > (𐑑).

AREV.justification: Contravariant morphism: the vapor descends, fixes, becomes body. Reverse transformation that brings the volatile down into fixed form. Corresponds to < (𐑿).

CLINK.justification: Composition of solve and coagula into a single circulation. Each ⋈ chains one sublimation to the next, building the ladder of degrees. Corresponds to ⋈ (𐑞).

IMSCRIB.justification: Identity/self-reference: the mercury that recognizes itself at the critical point. The stone that knows it is the stone. Corresponds to ⊙ (⊙) assigned to criticality_phase.

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication: one substance opens into two principles — the combustible (sulfur/T-arm) and the volatile (mercury/F-arm). The fork is the moment of separation. Corresponds to ∈ (𐑚).

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication: the two principles rejoin. If they agree, the stone is T; if they conflict, the stone holds B (both gold and dross simultaneously). The reunion does not erase the conflict — it preserves it as the stone's nature. Corresponds to ∋ (𐑠).

EVALT.justification: Constructive truth: the tincture proves itself by transmuting lead. The affirmative arm of the evaluation. Corresponds to ⊤ (𐑧) — kinetically frozen configuration, high barrier.

EVALF.justification: Constructive falsity: the caput mortuum remains dead. The negative arm of the evaluation. Corresponds to ⊥ (𐑖) — structurally enforced chirality, the principle that cannot be mirrored.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: the paradox vessel (holds gold and dross together)
ENGAGR.justification: Dialetheia: the B-state where the stone is both perfect and imperfect, both fixed and volatile. The container hierarchy (⊞/𐑳) holds partners without resolving them. This is the paradice — not a failure, the true nature of the lapis.

IFIX.justification: Linear fixation: each ◻ (𐑴) writes an append-only record of a cycle's outcome. The Z₂-graded topological invariant — parity of boundary crossings — protects the record from revision. Corresponds to IFIX.

phase_2.split_input: undifferentiated prima materia entering the alembic
phase_2.fuse_result: the philosopher's stone — a single substance that may be T (pure gold), F (pure dross), or B (the true lapis holding both natures simultaneously)
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The unopened alembic before prima materia is introduced — no sulfur, no mercury, no azoth, no record.
phase_3.true_description: The projection succeeds: lead becomes gold, the tincture passes the test, the stone is affirmed.
phase_3.false_description: The projection fails: the matter remains lead, the caput mortuum is confirmed dead, the stone is negated.
phase_3.both_description: The true lapis: simultaneously gold and dross, fixed and volatile, perfect and imperfect — the paradice held in the sealed vessel without resolution.

outer separatio for second work record

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The adept's intention translated into the sequence of operations — the recipe (receipt) that maps desire to laboratory action.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The laboratory journal (IFIX entries) stores each cycle's verdict append-only. The alembic itself holds the current register state (void/T/F/B) in its sealed interior.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The fire regimen — the timing of heat application determines when solve (AFWD) yields to coagula (AREV). The critical point (IMSCRIB) triggers the separatio (FSPLIT).
phase_5.alfs_store: The Turba Philosophorum — the canonical bootstrap store of operations, the collected sayings that ground every token in the tradition.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One unit of philosophical mercury (azoth) consumed per solve-coagula cycle; the fire burns whether the work succeeds or fails.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A sealed alembic containing prima materia at ambient temperature — register void (00), no sulfur, no mercury distinguished.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A sealed alembic containing the philosopher's stone — register T, F, or B depending on the projection; the journal holds the fixed record of every cycle.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The hermetic seal makes the system thermodynamically closed; the information gained in the journal (IFIX) exactly balances the entropy exported as waste heat from the fire. The Z₂ parity of boundary crossings (IFIX) conserves the topological invariant.

banked_count_check.surplus_note: a split between two deposits of the same value puts them in sibling regions; the fold keeps the larger rather than the sum. Put them in one region to keep both.
banked_count_check.remedy: open the region that holds the result BEFORE the region that computes it, and close them in that order, so the inner fuse folds into the enclosing frame rather than into the register
